name: mem_registry
description: List the registry hives of a Windows memory image, and read selected non-secret keys and values from one, through the installed Volatility 3, offline. Opt-in: it runs `windows.registry.hivelist` and `windows.registry.printkey`, the names taken from what `vol --offline --help` lists (a plugin the installed vol does not list is a refusal, not a guess). mode hivelist (the default): one record per hive found, with its offset, the path the hive names itself by and whether that path is a credential-class hive (SAM, SECURITY; a hive whose path hivelist could not read is taken as one, and says unnamed); the inventory names those hives, which is not a secret. mode printkey (needs `offset`, a hive's offset as hivelist lists it; `key` is the root by default; `recurse` reads the subtree): one record per subkey and per value. Every record carries hive_offset, plugin and volatility (the framework version Volatility prints); the answer carries coverage: hives_found, hives_named, hives_read, pages_missing_lines (lines of the engine's log that say pages were missing) and the record counts. Status is partial when pages were missing, when a hive had no readable name, when a limit, the clock or an output cap ended the read, when a row was too long or not in the form read, or when a hive's key gave no record; complete only when every hive was named and the key asked for was read to its end with no missing page reported (a heuristic over the engine's log: not a proof that the hive is whole). Records are paged: `limit` (default 100, at most 1000) in the answer and the whole set, as the same judged records, in a file under tool-output (in a job $OUT/tool-output) that `records.all_results` names; `max_records` (default 100000, at most 2000000) ends the read and the answer says so. NOT PRINTED: key names and values are free text from the capture and go through the shared SHOWN rules (a part that looks like a secret is replaced; withholding is by shape, so a plain password or a name under 16 characters is printed). A hive offset in the SAM or SECURITY hive, and a key under SAM, SECURITY, Policy\Secrets or SAM\Domains, are refused before the key is read and before anything is written unless write_values is true in a job run as secret output. The value of a record whose key path or value name carries a credential word (password, passwd, pwd, passphrase, secret, credential, token, verifier, hash, ntlm, lsa, dpapi, masterkey, bootkey, syskey, private, api key, access key, auth key, cachedlogon, protectedstorage, wdigest, vault) is withheld whole with its length, by that name and not by what it holds: a secret under an innocent name is printed if it does not look like one. A value of a binary or unknown type is not printed (its type and length are). write_values (default false) writes the withheld values, unjudged, to $OUT/mem_registry/mem_registry-<digest>-values.jsonl (directory mode 0700, file mode 0600, created exclusively under a hidden name and placed without replacing an earlier file; an identical second call in the job is named that file again, a different one takes the next free name); the answer carries secret_values (contains_secret_values, values_written, values_file, values_withheld) and never a value, a fragment or a digest. This manifest declares secret_output for write_values, so the harness seals such a job as sensitive, and the tool checks SECRET_OUTPUT=1 and refuses as JSON, before it looks at the image, when write_values is set outside a job or in a job that is not secret output. OFFLINE: every Volatility call carries `--offline`; the tool fetches nothing; a caller's text reaches Volatility only as an image path, a symbol directory, an offset (`--offset=0x…`) and a key (`--key=…`), each in a form an option cannot be mistaken for. THE CLOCK: `max_seconds` (default 420, at most 540, inside timeout_seconds 600); each program gets what is left less an 8 s reserve and, past its own time (help 90 s, hivelist 150 s) or output cap (16 MiB of help, 64 MiB of hivelist, 1 GiB of printkey, 64 MiB of an engine log read), is ended with what it started, in this tool's own process group (never a session of its own, PR_SET_PDEATHSIG on Linux); SIGTERM, SIGINT and SIGHUP end them and answer once with status failed, interrupted true, what had been counted, kept_results naming files that were being written (a name ending in .partial was cut by the stop), exit 128 plus the signal; a signal that arrives while the answer is written is held until it is out. Not measured: the real Volatility was not available where this tool was written. The columns of hivelist (Offset, FileFullPath, File output) and printkey (Last Write Time, Hive Offset, Type, Key, Name, Data, Volatile) and the options (--offset, --key, --recurse) were read from the Volatility 3 2.28.2 source; the tests' fixtures are hand-written to them, not recorded. Volatility yields a placeholder row (an unreadable name, type or data) for a key not found or a page not readable and logs why at debug level only: rows read as placeholders are counted (coverage.records.unreadable) and make the status partial, but how the quick renderer prints an unreadable cell is UNVERIFIED; the phrases that mean 'pages were missing' in the engine's log are a guess to be checked on a first real run. A name, a path, a URL or a message that quotes a credential is withheld with the identifier-shaped strings, from version 2: a value given to a password, token, secret or cookie name (password=..., Pwd=..., a Cookie header), a Name/Value pair in text whose Name is a credential (a number, an array or a long Value too, and the NewValue after an OldValue), a -Password style switch, the argument of ConvertTo-SecureString, curl -u user:pass, mysql -uUSER -pSECRET, a bcrypt hash and the known token families; the text is replaced by a marker that holds only its length. Before, only identifier-shaped strings (tokens, key ids, user-info) were withheld, so these were printed. Known gaps: a pair whose Value is an array nested in another or longer than 4,096 characters, a crypt hash that is not bcrypt, and a secret that has neither a credential name nor a token shape.

path.description: The memory image of a Windows machine. It is opened without waiting and looked at with fstat first: a FIFO, a directory or an empty file is refused.

mode.description: hivelist (default): the hive inventory. printkey: one key of one hive, with offset.

offset.description: printkey: the offset of the hive as hivelist lists it (0x followed by hexadecimal digits, or an integer)

key.description: printkey: the key to read, relative to the hive's root (default: the root)

recurse.description: printkey: read the subtree of the key, not only its own subkeys and values (default false)

write_values.description: Allow credential-class hives and keys, and write the withheld values to a file in the job. Only in a job run as secret output. Default false.

symbols_dir.description: A directory of symbol tables to search besides vol's own (passed as `-s`)

max_seconds.description: The clock of the whole call, 10 to 540 (default 420)

limit.description: How many records the answer lists inline, 1 to 1000 (default 100); the whole set is kept in a file the answer names

max_records.description: The most records read from printkey, 1 to 2000000 (default 100000); the answer says when the read ended there
